en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing several perspectives of a medieval hilltop castle complex and its surrounding town. The top panel displays a panoramic view of a town with steep‑roofed houses, church spire, and multiple stone towers rising above the trees. The three images in the lower row show close‑ups of the stone towers, curtain walls, arched gateway, and inner courtyard of the castle. In the center, a dark title panel bears white script text.
